title.value: Explainable AI: Towards Fairness, Accountability, Transparency and Trust in Healthcare
title.justification: The paper specifically addresses the aspects of explainability, fairness, accountability, transparency, and trust within the context of AI in healthcare.
title.quote: Guest Editorial Explainable AI: Towards Fairness, Accountability, Transparency and Trust in Healthcare

analysis.description: This paper discusses the role of Explainable AI (XAI) in healthcare, focusing on how it enhances fairness, accountability, transparency, and trust in AI-based systems. It highlights the complexity of current healthcare data and the necessity for explainability to ensure insights are understandable and trustworthy, thereby supporting better healthcare decision-making. The paper also reviews various applications of XAI in healthcare settings.

type.justification: The paper is a guest editorial that primarily discusses theoretical concepts and frameworks regarding explainable AI in healthcare rather than presenting new empirical data or experiments.
type.quote: This special issue includes the latest achievements in research and develop- ment in artificial intelligence with an emphasis on explainable models in public health and medicine.
